{"version":"Notebook/1.0","items":[{"type":1,"name":"header","content":{"json":"## GPU 卡时统计（DCGM + Azure Monitor）
卡时表格直接运行仓库 `kql/` 下的同名查询，与客户平台通过 API 得到的数字一致；趋势与运行状态面板来自 `azure/workbook/`。

- **分配**：VM 运行（有 Heartbeat）的分钟 × 卡数；**已观测**：其中收到 GPU 数据的 GPU·分钟；**未知** = 分配 − 已观测，不算空闲
- **占用**：有计算进程或 GPU Util ≥ 阈值；**有效计算**：Σ SM Active；**空闲** = 已观测 − 占用；**有效利用率** = 有效计算 ÷ 分配"}},{"type":9,"name":"parameters","content":{"version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","style":"pills","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","parameters":[{"id":"f3fa3c72-0308-568a-a11e-a9828c022511","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","name":"TimeRange","label":"时间范围 Time range","type":4,"isRequired":true,"value":{"durationMs":86400000},"typeSettings":{"selectableValues":[{"durationMs":3600000},{"durationMs":14400000},{"durationMs":43200000},{"durationMs":86400000},{"durationMs":604800000},{"durationMs":2592000000}],"allowCustom":true}},{"id":"92ebebe6-082e-5854-a4d7-b290ee2f9af2","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","name":"Computer","label":"GPU VM","type":2,"multiSelect":true,"quote":"'","delimiter":",","query":"GpuMetrics_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | distinct Computer | order by Computer asc","crossComponentResources":["__WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_ID__"],"timeContext":{"durationMs":2592000000},"typeSettings":{"additionalResourceOptions":["value::all"],"selectAllValue":"*","showDefault":false},"defaultValue":"value::all","value":["value::all"],"queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"},{"id":"dae129fa-8a38-50e9-83a5-621b37edc0e4","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","name":"IdlePct","label":"占用阈值 GPU Util %","type":1,"isRequired":true,"value":"5"},{"id":"9c08b819-0f6a-571c-b465-5c01eae9b7c4","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","name":"HasJobs","type":1,"isHiddenWhenLocked":true,"label":"AML job tracking","query":"let hasRunId = toscalar(GpuMetrics_CL | getschema | where ColumnName == 'RunId' | count) > 0;
let tables = union isfuzzy=true
    (AzureActivity | take 1 | project T = 'activity'),
    (AmlRunStatusChangedEvent | take 1 | project T = 'status'),
    (print T = 'none');
print Value = iff(hasRunId and toscalar(tables | where T != 'none' | summarize dcount(T)) == 2, 'yes', 'no')","crossComponentResources":["__WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_ID__"],"timeContext":{"durationMs":2592000000},"queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"}]}},{"type":12,"name":"status","content":{"version":"NotebookGroup/1.0","groupType":"editable","title":"采样状态 Sampling","items":[{"type":3,"name":"sampling_window","content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// Workbook panel: 所选范围与实际采样日期（北京时间）
// Workbook parameters: {TimeRange}, {Computer} ('*' = all VMs), {IdlePct}.
let windowStart = {TimeRange:start};
let windowEnd = {TimeRange:end};
let gpu = materialize(GpuMetrics_CL
| where TimeGenerated > windowStart and TimeGenerated <= windowEnd
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer}));
gpu
| summarize FirstSample = min(TimeGenerated), LastSample = max(TimeGenerated),
            Samples = count(), Days = make_set(format_datetime(TimeGenerated + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 366)
| project ['查询开始（北京时间）'] = format_datetime(windowStart + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),
          ['查询结束（北京时间）'] = format_datetime(windowEnd + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),
          ['实际采样日期'] = iff(Samples > 0, strcat_array(array_sort_asc(Days), '、'), '所选范围无 GPU 采样'),
          ['GPU采样条数'] = Samples,
          ['首次采样（北京时间）'] = format_datetime(FirstSample + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),
          ['最后采样（北京时间）'] = format_datetime(LastSample + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),
          ['趋势粒度（分钟）'] = iff(Samples > 0, toint(max_of(1.0, ceiling(((LastSample - FirstSample) / 1m + 1.0) / 720.0))), int(null)),
          ['查询结果生成时间（北京时间）'] = format_datetime(now() + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')
","size":0,"title":"所选范围与实际采样日期（北京时间）","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["__WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange"}},{"type":3,"name":"sampling_status","content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// Workbook panel: 近30天采样状态（独立于所选范围）
// Workbook parameters: {TimeRange}, {Computer} ('*' = all VMs), {IdlePct}.
GpuMetrics_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer})
| summarize LastSample = max(TimeGenerated)
| project ['近30天最后采样（北京时间）'] = format_datetime(LastSample + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),
          ['采样状态'] = case(isnull(LastSample), '近30天无GPU采样',
                              LastSample < ago(15m), '最近15分钟无采样，历史数据不代表当前运行状态',
                              '最近15分钟内有GPU采样')
","size":0,"title":"近 30 天采样状态（独立于所选范围）","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["__WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","timeContext":{"durationMs":2592000000}}}]}},{"type":12,"name":"hours","content":{"version":"NotebookGroup/1.0","groupType":"editable","title":"卡时 GPU-hours","items":[{"type":3,"name":"summary_tiles","content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// GPU hours for all selected VMs together.
//   az monitor log-analytics query -w <workspace-guid> --analytics-query @kql/summary.kql -t P1D
// The time window is the query timespan (-t, or "timespan" in the REST request body).
let IdlePct = {IdlePct};              // a GPU-minute is busy when a compute process runs or GPU util >= IdlePct
let Computers = set_difference(dynamic([{Computer}]), dynamic(['*']));  // VM names to include; empty = all VMs that report GPU metrics
let gpu = GpuMetrics_CL | where array_length(Computers) == 0 or Computer in (Computers);
let gpus = gpu | summarize Gpus = dcount(GpuId) by Computer;
let heartbeat = Heartbeat | where Computer in ((gpus | project Computer));
let heartbeat_minutes = heartbeat | distinct Computer, M = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m);
let per_vm = heartbeat
| summarize RunningMinutes = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)) by Computer
| join kind=inner gpus on Computer
| project Computer, Gpus, RunningHours = RunningMinutes / 60.0, AllocatedGpuHours = RunningMinutes * Gpus / 60.0
| join kind=leftouter (gpu
    | extend M = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
    | join kind=inner heartbeat_minutes on Computer, M
    | summarize ObservedGpuHours = dcount(strcat(GpuId, '|', bin(TimeGenerated, 1m))) / 60.0,
                BusyGpuHours = countif(ProcCount > 0 or GpuUtil >= IdlePct) / 60.0,
                EffectiveGpuHours = sum(coalesce(SmActive, 0.0)) / 60.0,
                VmSize = take_any(VmSize), GpuName = take_any(GpuName) by Computer) on Computer
| project Computer, VmSize, GpuName, Gpus, RunningHours, AllocatedGpuHours,
          ObservedGpuHours = coalesce(ObservedGpuHours, 0.0),
          BusyGpuHours = coalesce(BusyGpuHours, 0.0), EffectiveGpuHours = coalesce(EffectiveGpuHours, 0.0)
| extend IdleGpuHours = max_of(ObservedGpuHours - BusyGpuHours, 0.0),
         UnknownGpuHours = max_of(AllocatedGpuHours - ObservedGpuHours, 0.0),
         TelemetryCoveragePct = iff(AllocatedGpuHours > 0, 100.0 * ObservedGpuHours / AllocatedGpuHours, 0.0),
         UtilizationPct = iff(AllocatedGpuHours > 0, 100.0 * EffectiveGpuHours / AllocatedGpuHours, 0.0);
per_vm
| summarize AllocatedGpuHours = sum(AllocatedGpuHours), BusyGpuHours = sum(BusyGpuHours),
            EffectiveGpuHours = sum(EffectiveGpuHours), IdleGpuHours = sum(IdleGpuHours),
            ObservedGpuHours = sum(ObservedGpuHours), UnknownGpuHours = sum(UnknownGpuHours),
            Vms = count(), Gpus = sum(Gpus)
| extend TelemetryCoveragePct = iff(AllocatedGpuHours > 0, 100.0 * ObservedGpuHours / AllocatedGpuHours, 0.0),
         UtilizationPct = iff(AllocatedGpuHours > 0, 100.0 * EffectiveGpuHours / AllocatedGpuHours, 0.0)
| project Metric = pack_array('① 分配卡时 Allocated', '② 已观测卡时 Observed', '③ 占用卡时 Busy', '④ 有效计算卡时 Effective',
                              '⑤ 空闲卡时 Idle', '⑥ 未知卡时 Unknown', '⑦ 遥测覆盖率 Coverage %', '⑧ 有效利用率 Utilization %'),
          Value = pack_array(round(AllocatedGpuHours, 2), round(ObservedGpuHours, 2), round(BusyGpuHours, 2),
                             round(EffectiveGpuHours, 2), round(IdleGpuHours, 2), round(UnknownGpuHours, 2),
                             round(TelemetryCoveragePct, 1), round(UtilizationPct, 1))
| mv-expand Metric to typeof(string), Value to typeof(real)
","size":0,"title":"卡时汇总（kql/summary.kql）","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["__WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_ID__"],"visualization":"tiles","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange","tileSettings":{"titleContent":{"columnMatch":"Metric","formatter":1},"leftContent":{"columnMatch":"Value","formatter":12,"formatOptions":{"palette":"blue"},"numberFormat":{"unit":17,"options":{"style":"decimal","maximumFractionDigits":2}}},"showBorder":true}}},{"type":3,"name":"per_vm","content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// GPU hours per VM: allocated, busy, effective, idle and utilization.

let IdlePct = {IdlePct};              // a GPU-minute is busy when a compute process runs or GPU util >= IdlePct
let Computers = set_difference(dynamic([{Computer}]), dynamic(['*']));  // VM names to include; empty = all VMs that report GPU metrics

let gpus = gpu | summarize Gpus = dcount(GpuId) by Computer;

heartbeat
| summarize RunningMinutes = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)) by Computer
| join kind=inner gpus on Computer
| project Computer, Gpus, RunningHours = RunningMinutes / 60.0, AllocatedGpuHours = RunningMinutes * Gpus / 60.0
| join kind=leftouter (gpu
    | extend M = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
    | join kind=inner heartbeat_minutes on Computer, M
    | summarize ObservedGpuHours = dcount(strcat(GpuId, '|', bin(TimeGenerated, 1m))) / 60.0,
                BusyGpuHours = countif(ProcCount > 0 or GpuUtil >= IdlePct) / 60.0,
                EffectiveGpuHours = sum(coalesce(SmActive, 0.0)) / 60.0,
                VmSize = take_any(VmSize), GpuName = take_any(GpuName) by Computer) on Computer
| project Computer, VmSize, GpuName, Gpus, RunningHours, AllocatedGpuHours,
          ObservedGpuHours = coalesce(ObservedGpuHours, 0.0),
          BusyGpuHours = coalesce(BusyGpuHours, 0.0), EffectiveGpuHours = coalesce(EffectiveGpuHours, 0.0)
| extend IdleGpuHours = max_of(ObservedGpuHours - BusyGpuHours, 0.0),
         UnknownGpuHours = max_of(AllocatedGpuHours - ObservedGpuHours, 0.0),
         TelemetryCoveragePct = iff(AllocatedGpuHours > 0, 100.0 * ObservedGpuHours / AllocatedGpuHours, 0.0),
         UtilizationPct = iff(AllocatedGpuHours > 0, 100.0 * EffectiveGpuHours / AllocatedGpuHours, 0.0)
| order by AllocatedGpuHours desc, Computer asc
","size":0,"title":"按 VM（kql/per_vm.kql）","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["__WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange"}},{"type":3,"name":"per_hour","content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// GPU hours per local hour for all selected VMs together.
//   az monitor log-analytics query -w <workspace-guid> --analytics-query @kql/per_hour.kql -t P1D
// The time window is the query timespan (-t, or "timespan" in the REST request body).
let IdlePct = {IdlePct};              // a GPU-minute is busy when a compute process runs or GPU util >= IdlePct
let TzOffset = 8h;            // UTC offset of the reporting time zone (8h = Beijing time)
let Computers = set_difference(dynamic([{Computer}]), dynamic(['*']));  // VM names to include; empty = all VMs that report GPU metrics
let gpu = GpuMetrics_CL | where array_length(Computers) == 0 or Computer in (Computers);
let gpus = gpu | summarize Gpus = dcount(GpuId) by Computer;
let heartbeat = Heartbeat | where Computer in ((gpus | project Computer));
let heartbeat_minutes = heartbeat | distinct Computer, M = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m);
let observed = gpu | extend M = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m) | join kind=inner heartbeat_minutes on Computer, M;
heartbeat
| summarize RunningMinutes = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)) by Computer, B = bin(TimeGenerated + TzOffset, 1h)
| join kind=inner gpus on Computer
| summarize AllocatedGpuHours = sum(RunningMinutes * Gpus) / 60.0 by B
| join kind=leftouter (observed
    | summarize ObservedGpuHours = dcount(strcat(Computer, '|', GpuId, '|', bin(TimeGenerated, 1m))) / 60.0,
                BusyGpuHours = countif(ProcCount > 0 or GpuUtil >= IdlePct) / 60.0,
                EffectiveGpuHours = sum(coalesce(SmActive, 0.0)) / 60.0 by B = bin(TimeGenerated + TzOffset, 1h)) on B
| project B, AllocatedGpuHours, ObservedGpuHours = coalesce(ObservedGpuHours, 0.0),
          BusyGpuHours = coalesce(BusyGpuHours, 0.0), EffectiveGpuHours = coalesce(EffectiveGpuHours, 0.0)
| extend IdleGpuHours = max_of(ObservedGpuHours - BusyGpuHours, 0.0),
         UnknownGpuHours = max_of(AllocatedGpuHours - ObservedGpuHours, 0.0),
         TelemetryCoveragePct = iff(AllocatedGpuHours > 0, 100.0 * ObservedGpuHours / AllocatedGpuHours, 0.0),
         UtilizationPct = iff(AllocatedGpuHours > 0, 100.0 * EffectiveGpuHours / AllocatedGpuHours, 0.0)
| order by B asc
| project Hour = format_datetime(B, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), AllocatedGpuHours, ObservedGpuHours, BusyGpuHours,
          EffectiveGpuHours, IdleGpuHours, UnknownGpuHours, TelemetryCoveragePct, UtilizationPct
| project Hour, AllocatedGpuHours, ObservedGpuHours, BusyGpuHours, EffectiveGpuHours, UnknownGpuHours
","size":0,"title":"每小时卡时（kql/per_hour.kql，北京时间）","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["__WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_ID__"],"visualization":"unstackedbar","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange","chartSettings":{"xAxis":"Hour","showLegend":true}}},{"type":3,"name":"per_day","content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// GPU hours per local day for all selected VMs together.
//   az monitor log-analytics query -w <workspace-guid> --analytics-query @kql/per_day.kql -t P30D
// The time window is the query timespan (-t, or "timespan" in the REST request body).
// For whole local days, start and end the timespan at local midnight expressed in UTC.
let IdlePct = {IdlePct};              // a GPU-minute is busy when a compute process runs or GPU util >= IdlePct
let TzOffset = 8h;            // UTC offset of the reporting time zone (8h = Beijing time)
let Computers = set_difference(dynamic([{Computer}]), dynamic(['*']));  // VM names to include; empty = all VMs that report GPU metrics
let gpu = GpuMetrics_CL | where array_length(Computers) == 0 or Computer in (Computers);
let gpus = gpu | summarize Gpus = dcount(GpuId) by Computer;
let heartbeat = Heartbeat | where Computer in ((gpus | project Computer));
let heartbeat_minutes = heartbeat | distinct Computer, M = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m);
let observed = gpu | extend M = bin(TimeGenerated, 1m) | join kind=inner heartbeat_minutes on Computer, M;
heartbeat
| summarize RunningMinutes = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)) by Computer, B = startofday(TimeGenerated + TzOffset)
| join kind=inner gpus on Computer
| summarize AllocatedGpuHours = sum(RunningMinutes * Gpus) / 60.0 by B
| join kind=leftouter (observed
    | summarize ObservedGpuHours = dcount(strcat(Computer, '|', GpuId, '|', bin(TimeGenerated, 1m))) / 60.0,
                BusyGpuHours = countif(ProcCount > 0 or GpuUtil >= IdlePct) / 60.0,
                EffectiveGpuHours = sum(coalesce(SmActive, 0.0)) / 60.0 by B = startofday(TimeGenerated + TzOffset)) on B
| project B, AllocatedGpuHours, ObservedGpuHours = coalesce(ObservedGpuHours, 0.0),
          BusyGpuHours = coalesce(BusyGpuHours, 0.0), EffectiveGpuHours = coalesce(EffectiveGpuHours, 0.0)
| extend IdleGpuHours = max_of(ObservedGpuHours - BusyGpuHours, 0.0),
         UnknownGpuHours = max_of(AllocatedGpuHours - ObservedGpuHours, 0.0),
         TelemetryCoveragePct = iff(AllocatedGpuHours > 0, 100.0 * ObservedGpuHours / AllocatedGpuHours, 0.0),
         UtilizationPct = iff(AllocatedGpuHours > 0, 100.0 * EffectiveGpuHours / AllocatedGpuHours, 0.0)
| order by B asc
| project Day = format_datetime(B, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), AllocatedGpuHours, ObservedGpuHours, BusyGpuHours,
          EffectiveGpuHours, IdleGpuHours, UnknownGpuHours, TelemetryCoveragePct, UtilizationPct
","size":0,"title":"按天（kql/per_day.kql，北京时间）","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["__WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange"}},{"type":3,"name":"per_user","content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// GPU hours per process owner (Linux user of the compute process on the GPU).
//   az monitor log-analytics query -w <workspace-guid> --analytics-query @kql/per_user.kql -t P1D
// The time window is the query timespan (-t, or "timespan" in the REST request body).
// A GPU-minute shared by N owners counts 1/N for each, so the owners' busy hours add up to the
// busy hours that have an owner. Busy minutes with no visible process owner are not attributed.
let Computers = set_difference(dynamic([{Computer}]), dynamic(['*']));  // VM names to include; empty = all VMs that report GPU metrics
let gpu = GpuMetrics_CL | where array_length(Computers) == 0 or Computer in (Computers);
gpu
| where isnotempty(Users)
| extend Owners = split(Users, ','), N = array_length(split(Users, ','))
| mv-expand User = Owners to typeof(string)
| summarize BusyGpuHours = sum(1.0 / N) / 60.0, EffectiveGpuHours = sum(coalesce(SmActive, 0.0) / N) / 60.0,
            AvgSmActivePct = 100.0 * avg(SmActive), PeakMemoryGiB = max(FbUsedMiB) / 1024.0,
            Processes = strcat_array(make_set(Processes, 10), ',')
          by User, Computer
| order by BusyGpuHours desc, User asc
","size":0,"title":"按 Linux 用户（kql/per_user.kql）","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["__WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange"}}]}},{"type":12,"name":"trends","content":{"version":"NotebookGroup/1.0","groupType":"editable","title":"GPU 趋势 Trends","items":[{"type":3,"name":"trend_utilization","content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// Workbook panel: GPU 利用率趋势（SM Active / GPU Util / Tensor）
// Workbook parameters: {TimeRange}, {Computer} ('*' = all VMs), {IdlePct}.
let windowStart = {TimeRange:start};
let windowEnd = {TimeRange:end};
let gpu = materialize(GpuMetrics_CL
| where TimeGenerated > windowStart and TimeGenerated <= windowEnd
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer}));
let firstSample = toscalar(gpu | summarize min(TimeGenerated));
let lastSample = toscalar(gpu | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
let grainMinutes = toint(max_of(1.0, ceiling(((lastSample - firstSample) / 1m + 1.0) / 720.0)));
let g = grainMinutes * 1m;
let axisStart = bin(coalesce(firstSample, windowStart), g);
let axisEnd = bin(coalesce(lastSample, windowStart), g) + g;
gpu
| extend Gpu = strcat(Computer, '/GPU', GpuId)
| make-series SM = avg(SmActive) default=real(null), Util = avg(GpuUtil) default=real(null),
              Tensor = avg(TensorActive) default=real(null)
              on TimeGenerated from axisStart to axisEnd step g by Gpu
| mv-expand TimeGenerated to typeof(datetime), SM to typeof(real), Util to typeof(real), Tensor to typeof(real)
| project TimeGenerated, Gpu, ['SM Active %'] = SM * 100.0, ['GPU Util %'] = Util, ['Tensor Active %'] = Tensor * 100.0
| order by TimeGenerated asc, Gpu asc
